comparison.heading: How it compares
comparison.subheading: Competing tools charge per user or per job — costs grow as your team grows. Here they don't.

items.q: Does the price change as my business grows?
items.a: No. Whether you have 5 or 50 cleaners, it's the same A$500/month. Tools like Jobber and ServiceM8 charge per user — your costs rise as you grow. Not here.
No. Configuration, white-label branding, custom domain and team training are all included in the first month.
3-month initial contract. After that, month-to-month with 30 days' notice to cancel. Your code and data are always yours — no lock-in.
Bank transfer (Australia) or Wise. Stripe for automated recurring billing available if you prefer.
